text:
Maria: Heads-up — ClearBank reporting embeddings p99 spike on v2 since 10:30 UTC. CS says this hits SLA risk if we don't mitigate before EOD. Need an owner for a weekend workaround + someone to cut an RC and get a quick PR reviewed.
Oncall Bot: Incident created: <https://redwood.incidents/INC-4421|INC-4421> (severity: high) — symptoms: embeddings p99 > 1.6s, error rate remains low.
Ajay: @Maria grabbing logs now. Is this only for ClearBank or other tenants impacted?
Maria: @Ajay ClearBank only so far, looks request-shape heavy (long sequences). We saw a few spikes on a dedicated pool but mostly hosted customers.
Sam: I can add a routing fallback and open a PR for a quantized embed model option. Will need a quick code review and a canary rollout.
Chen: If we fallback to the q4 variant, we need to ensure tokenization parity. Also confirm the KV cache path compatibility; otherwise prefix cache misses could blow latency.
Priya: Suggest temp rate-limit per API key for ClearBank to give us breathing room while patch lands. CS can enable via the console if we confirm numbers.
Ajay: @Sam please put the routing as a policy flagged-on by customer id, not global. Also add a max_concurrency override.
Sam: on it. Draft config snippet below — will push PR shortly:
```
routing_policies:
  - match: customer:clearbank
    fallback_model: text-embed-lite-q4
    max_concurrency: 8
    rollout: canary(2)
```
Sam: PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321|infra#4321> — requests review from @Ajay and @Chen. Small changes: config + canary manifest.
Ajay: Reviewing now. One nit: set rollout canary to 1 minute ramp + healthcheck path /healthz?check=embed to reduce risk.
Chen: added notes on KV cache in the PR. Also, I'll prepare a short test plan to validate prefix hit-rate and a smoke script.
Sam: Updated PR with healthcheck and 1m ramp. Pushed canary to 2 pods in us-west-2. Canary ID: canary-rc-2026-03-17.
Oncall Bot: Deployment event: canary-rc-2026-03-17 -> 2/2 pods ready. (link: <https://deploys.redwood/canary-rc-2026-03-17>)
Maria: Good. @Priya can you coordinate with CS to enable the rate-limit for ClearBank to 15 TPS while we observe? We should also tell them ETA for rollback plan.
Priya: Will do. Messaging to CS: "We rolled a canary routing fallback to a quantized embed variant and enabled temp rate-limits. We'll observe for 30m and escalate if any regressions."
Chen: Metrics look stable so far (p50/p90 back to normal, p99 trending down). Keeping canary for 30m and running smoke script every 60s.
Sam: After 25m: canary metrics still green. Increasing rollout to 20% (10 pods).
Oncall Bot: Deployment event: canary-rc-2026-03-17 -> scale to 10 pods.
Ajay: Monitoring dashboards show p99 sitting ~1.1s — under SLA. Still watching errors.
Maria: Nice work. Action items: (1) Sam: finalize PR and merge if no regressions in next 30m. (2) Chen: run full prefix-hit smoke run and post results. (3) Priya: confirm CS notified and ClearBank rate-limit in place. (4) Ajay: prep rollback steps if we see errors.
Sam: Merge scheduled if green. I'll also add a short rollback block to the PR: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embed-router --to-revision=prev` and a runbook note.
Chen: Smoke run completed — prefix-hit stable at 92%, no KV errors. Pushing results to the PR.
Priya: CS confirmed rate-limit applied, customer notified that we're rolling a patch and monitoring.
Ajay: Rollback playbook in #runbooks: `runbook/embed-fallback-rollback.md` — I've updated steps and added ops contacts.
Maria: If all stays green, we'll keep the new routing for 24h then schedule a tech-debt ticket to evaluate model variant permanently. Thank you — closing this thread when PR merged and CS confirms customer happy. :thumbsup:
Sam: PR merged at 3201234685. Canary promotion complete.
Oncall Bot: INC-4421 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring.
Maria: Marking this done for eng-oncall. If any regressions, reopen INC-4421 and ping this thread.
Priya: Thanks team.
Sam: Closing — will follow up on the tech-debt ticket next week.
